title: Staff can waive every limit on a Space, for comp accounts

source.ref: owner ruling 2026-10-06 21:45 comp Space with no limits

detail:
Owner ruling (Daniel, 2026-10-06 21:45): "My space should be a Collective account with no limits." Collective still counts (QR codes 5, operator seats 5, contacts 25,000, sends, automation runs), so a plan change alone cannot do it.

Shipped: migration 20270346004360 adds spaces.limits_waived boolean not null default false, set only by staff in the SQL editor. Owners cannot write it: spaces has RLS on with one SELECT policy and no UPDATE policy, and new columns are not in the column-level SELECT grant (the same posture as beta_price_grant). lib/pricing/space-allowance.ts spaceLimitsWaived(spaceId) is the one reader (its own request, fail-closed to false). The meter seam spaceAllowanceVerdict asks it when a cap would apply and passes limitsWaived to allowanceVerdict (lib/pricing/feature-meters.ts), which resolves the allowance to null, so every counted write (contacts, sends, QR codes, bookings, tiers, circles, events, guests, services, listings, funnels, automations) is unlimited. checkSeatForOperatorInvite lifts the seat cap. meetsGate/featureAllowed take limitsWaived and gate the Space at Collective (limitsWaivedPlan in lib/pricing/plans.ts); the Space function gates, collaborator hosting, automation, members-only tickets, campaigns, the payments gate and the custom domain gate ask the flag on a refusal only. lib/database.types.ts carries the column. The public pricing page is unchanged.

To comp the owner's Space: set plan = 'collective' (so the plan-keyed entitlements such as Vera AI are written) and limits_waived = true, in the SQL editor, after this migration is applied.

verify.cmd: node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const r=(f)=>fs.existsSync(f)?fs.readFileSync(f,"utf8"):"";const fail=(m)=>{console.error(m);process.exit(1)};const m=r("supabase/migrations/20270346004360_space_limits_waived.sql");if(!/add column if not exists limits_waived boolean not null default false/.test(m))fail("no spaces.limits_waived migration");const a=r("lib/pricing/space-allowance.ts");if(!/export async function spaceLimitsWaived/.test(a)||!/select\(.limits_waived.\)/.test(a))fail("no spaceLimitsWaived reader of limits_waived");if(!/spaceLimitsWaived\(id\)/.test(a))fail("the meter seam does not ask spaceLimitsWaived");if(!/limitsWaived/.test(r("lib/pricing/feature-meters.ts"))||!/limitsWaived/.test(r("lib/pricing/gates.ts")))fail("caps or gates ignore limitsWaived");console.log("ok: staff can waive every limit on a Space")'
